source_evidence.fact: server-owned cumulative counters, current gauges and bounded latency/token aggregates are updated independently from the Prometheus text exporter
one scheduler iteration updates request/token/cache counters, running/waiting/cache gauges and block lifetime/idle/reuse histograms
scheduler metrics include floating cumulative work, NaN gauges, fixed histogram observations and a repeated-value observation weighted by newly generated token count
fixed-bucket/repeated-value aggregation and sharded counter state establish mature ownership and snapshot alternatives

journeys.ownership: one scheduler or worker owns the aggregation object
journeys.shape: one iteration updates two integral counters, one floating counter, two gauges and a six-bound histogram for 64 request records; histogram multiplicity is the request token count
journeys.candidate: HYLE owner-thread metric value objects with runtime-validated caller-owned bounds
journeys.peer: direct plain arithmetic and array storage with the same runtime bounds, validity checks, bucket search, update count and observable lifetime

journeys.ownership: workers explicitly share one aggregation object and require immediate lock-free values
journeys.shape: the same iteration and input distribution use relaxed lock-free atomic counters/gauges/histogram storage
journeys.peer: direct std::atomic fields and the same runtime bounds, validity checks, bucket search, memory order, update count and observable lifetime

semantic_equivalence.setup: both sides receive the same already-validated runtime boundary array and persistent zeroed aggregation lifetime outside timing
semantic_equivalence.charged: identical deterministic per-iteration request/token/latency values, numeric validity checks, bucket lookup and numeric updates
semantic_equivalence.excluded: names, labels, exporters, clocks, scrape snapshots, process/network I/O and construction-time boundary validation
semantic_equivalence.oracle: an untimed one-iteration comparison requires identical counters, gauges, exclusive bucket counts and sum
